svg.text: PART 4 OPENER — the toolbox begins here
An enhanced career is finite by default — a health crisis or a hairline usually
ends it. Protection is the art of extending it: every move either slows the drain
on a finite vessel or catches damage early enough to reverse. Defend each front.
Reach for the clever cross-ties. And never let a drug stand in for the foundations.
One set of organs. ~100,000 follicles. Protection
is how long you make it last.
the binary that organises the whole board
DHT on genetically susceptible follicles — a cycle can turn "thinning" into permanent "balding."
Your FIRST defense is the compound you DON'T run — 5-ARIs (finasteride / dutasteride) can't touch DHT-derivatives that
bypass the enzyme (Masteron · Winstrol · Anavar). Then: topical fin · minoxidil · ketoconazole.
⚑ RU58841 = research chem, no long-term human safety — flagged, not endorsed.

The moderate, multi-pathway approach + close monitoring ARE protection — the single biggest protective decision you make. Everything above only layers on top.
Harm reduction, not medical advice — every named drug is physician territory.
